_source: app.notion.com sandbox page, measured 2026-08-26 (scratchpad/m-plus-4/5/6.mjs, + clicked after Page.bringToFront)

behaviour.contentLine: creates a new empty line below and the menu opens on that line
behaviour.emptyLine: adds no line; the menu opens on that line
behaviour.clickOnSameLine: menu closes, the line goes back to the default text

placeholder._note: The original prefixes "AI 기능은 '스페이스 키', " ("AI features: press space, "), but this service has no AI features, so it was dropped (comcom decision, 2026-08-26)
